name: The Mosaic Path of Living Tiles
description: An infinite pathway where each tile is a tiny living ecosystem -- moss, micro-ferns, crystalline lichen, bioluminescent bacteria. The path changes pattern seasonally as tiles bloom, fruit, spore, and hibernate. Walking it is tending a linear garden.
prompt: An endless winding path through varied landscapes (forest, desert, mountain, coast). Each 'tile' (1m hexagon) is a self-contained micro-ecosystem visible in cross-section: living moss carpets, tiny fern forests, crystalline lichen geodes, bioluminescent bacterial pools. Tiles connect seamlessly but each is unique. Seasonal transition captured: some tiles blooming (spring), some fruiting (summer), some sporing (autumn), some dormant but glowing (winter). Footprints cause tiles to pulse with light. The path maintains itself -- tiles exchange nutrients through hidden root-network. Macro detail on micro-ecosystems, wide view on infinite path. Botanical accuracy, magical stewardship.
caption: Every step tends a garden. 🌱🛤️ Each tile a world. Each season a new mosaic. Your footfall wakes the bioluminescence. The path remembers every traveler. Where does it lead? Only the tiles know.
